WITH
d1_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d2_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d3_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
sales_returns_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN d1_filtered AS d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns AS sr
      ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
     AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN d2_filtered AS d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
),
sales_returns_grouped AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        ssr.ss_customer_sk,
        ssr.ss_item_sk,
        max(ssr.ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit,
        max(ssr.sr_net_loss) AS sr_net_loss
    FROM sales_returns_filtered AS ssr
    JOIN item AS i
      ON i.i_item_sk = ssr.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store AS s
      ON s.s_store_sk = ssr.ss_store_sk
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        ssr.ss_customer_sk,
        ssr.ss_item_sk
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN d3_filtered AS d3
      ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
catalog_sales_grouped AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        csf.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        csf.cs_item_sk,
        max(csf.cs_net_profit) AS cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales_filtered AS csf
    GROUP BY
        csf.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        csf.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    srg.i_item_id,
    srg.i_item_desc,
    srg.s_store_id,
    srg.s_store_name,
    max(srg.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    max(srg.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    max(csg.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM sales_returns_grouped AS srg
JOIN catalog_sales_grouped AS csg
  ON csg.cs_bill_customer_sk = srg.ss_customer_sk
 AND csg.cs_item_sk = srg.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY
    srg.i_item_id,
    srg.i_item_desc,
    srg.s_store_id,
    srg.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    srg.i_item_id,
    srg.i_item_desc,
    srg.s_store_id,
    srg.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
